problems.explain: a = 1, b = 6, c = 7. b² − 4ac = 36 − 4 × 1 × 7 = 8. n = (−6 ± √8) / 2. Simplify the root: √8 = √(4 × 2) = 2√2, so n = (−6 ± 2√2) / 2. Every part divides by 2. So n = −3 ± √2.
